patch_resolves_note: The bundled patch.diff and the fixed image's copied lib/x509/pkcs12.c are both source-identical to the vulnerable pkcs12.c around _pkcs12_decode_safe_contents. The staged fixed execution is nevertheless clean because the generated compare path only consumes the 4-byte initialized prefix before the first mismatch, whereas the vulnerable execution reaches a 22-byte memcmp-style read.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code statement that consumes the attacker-controlled DER witness and materializes it into the PKCS#12 ASN.1 tree later traversed by gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag.

The SafeBag dispatch buffer oid is stack-allocated without zero-initialization and then reused across bagId parsing and bag-attribute parsing; on the staged witness, the later attribute read does not make the whole buffer defined, so strcmp(oid, KEY_ID_OID) reads bytes MSAN still marks uninitialized.

MSAN crash site. After a successful bag-attribute decode, the dispatch compares the partially initialized stack buffer oid against the 21-character KEY_ID_OID literal, and the compare consumes oid's uninitialized tail.
Intermediate runtime event attr_oid_read materialized from verified transition assertion A-ATTRIBUTE-OID-BUFFER-TO-KEY-ID-DISPATCH.

edges.description: The same `oid` stack buffer filled by `_gnutls_x509_decode_and_read_attribute()` is passed unchanged to the later KEY_ID_OID dispatch.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable trace records the same oid buffer address at attr_oid_read and key_id_dispatch.
